types.title: Stock Types
types.description: Allowed stock types. Currently 3 are available. Steady: Cost will rise/lower every tick based on a trend with little variance. Volatile: Still follows trends, but has a higher variance. Sporadic: Completely random, with a 50/50 chance to either increase or decrease each tick.

trends.title: Stock Trends
trends.description: Allowed trend types. Currently 3 are available. Up: Variance will favor positive increments. Down: Variance will favor negative increments. Stagnant: Variance will not be affected much by trend.

maxCreates.title: Max Stock Creation Per User
maxCreates.description: Maximum number of stocks to be created by a single user.

maxHistory.title: Max Stock History to Store
maxHistory.description: Amount of ticks to keep historical data for.

showHistory.title: Stock History to Show
showHistory.description: Amount of ticks to show historical data for when using `$$stocks view`.

updateFrequency.title: Stock Update Frequency
updateFrequency.description: Amount of time (in MS) between ticks.

dividendFrequency.title: Stock Dividend Payout Frequency
dividendFrequency.description: Amount of time (in MS) between dividend payouts. Currently unused.

createBounds.title: Stock Creation Value Bounds
createBounds.description: Value of a stock when initially created using `$$stocks create`.

shareBounds.title: Stock Creation Share Bounds
shareBounds.description: Amount of shares created for a stock when initially created using `$$stocks create`.

creatorSharesUpperPercent.title: Creator Shares Upper Percent
creatorSharesUpperPercent.description: Maximum percentage of available shares to give to the stock's creator.

typeActivatePercent.title: Type Activation Percent
typeActivatePercent.description: Percentage for a specific stock type to activate its unique variance effect.

volatile.title: Volatile
volatile.description: Percentage chance for a volatile stock to have a spike in variance.

trendPercent.description: Controls changes to variance based on trend.
